summary: Distractor collisions exclude valid moderate cases, including the canonical lesson example. The requested five easy records pass math, grading, delivery and rendering. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Determine rank from a stated pivot-column count (easy) or subtract non-pivot count from total columns (moderate).
reasoning_steps: Identify matrix dimensions and whether stated columns are pivots or non-pivots.
For easy recall rank equals pivot count; for moderate compute columns minus non-pivots.
invariants: Five distinct numeric radio options with exactly one correct answer.
Easy items give pivot count; moderate items give non-pivot count.
No row reduction or explicit matrix computation is needed.
permitted_variations: Matrix name, dimensions, pivot count/rank and non-pivot count within feasible bounds.
Square, tall and wide dimensions; zero and full rank are mathematically valid conservative boundary extensions.
Correct-option location and distractor values/bank profiles may vary.
Dimensions are irrelevant to easy response once feasibility is assured; moderate column count and non-pivot count are relevant.
Fixed target rank(A) and one correct radio choice are essential; particular letter, dimensions, rank, answer position and source bank are incidental.

decision_variation.details: Feasible irrelevant row change breaks generation and rank=nonpivot cases are omitted. Exact easy batch has no demonstrated universal tested shortcut; this does not waive the moderate restriction.

findings.description: valid() requires the original distractor recipe to contain five distinct values before variant-bank construction. All moderate recipes contain both rows and rank, excluding every full-row-rank matrix, including canonical 4x7 with three non-pivots (rank four). Every profile also rejects columns=2*nonpivots: minimal 3x4 with two non-pivots has rank two and admits five distinct choices such as 0,1,2,3,4. These are same-method cases, not additional prerequisites.

findings.requested_change: Separate mathematical feasibility from source-distractor uniqueness. Preserve complete source banks on exact replay; construct or replace colliding distractors for valid extensions. Include full-row-rank and rank=nonpivot cases in the catalog and retain the strict regression. Verify dependent prompt, solution, key, real grading and delivery.
